=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:411-468, 532-547 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merged-integration-PR path in `verify_resolution` reuses `_default_branch_evidence`, which takes the first result from completed default-branch runs only, not necessarily the run for the current default-branch tip.
  WHY: If a newer default-branch run is still pending, an older successful run whose commit already contains the integration merge can pass the final compare, so the triage issue closes before the current default tip has a green check (both reviewers rated it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed it because the issue says to reuse the check unchanged).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15217-15219 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` is retried only once, which is weaker than the `gh_retry` used elsewhere.
  WHY: If posting fails permanently, `.tracking_auto_close` outcome is set but no state comment is posted, so someone who reopens the issue cannot tell it was closed automatically (rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed it as documented residual risk).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add tests (see Tests). tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py: drive the function with a stub gh and fixture STATE_FILE, COMMENTS and labels."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py (new file)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff and last-run diff contain `tests/orchestrate_tracking_auto_close_cases.py` instead of the requested `tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py`, the PR introduces tests/orchestrate_tracking_auto_close_cases.py (no test_ prefix) and a shim in tests/test_activation_verify.py:_collect_tracking_auto_close_cases that re-exports each test_* (pytest discovers them, with a `collected >= 10` guard), but the file is not named test_* (gemini rated MAJOR, minimax rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dismissed it as a deferral forced by the ci.yml grant)
- requirement: "A PR merged into orchestrator/project-<N> reaches the default branch only inside the project's squash commit, so its own merge commit is never an ancestor of the default tip. … Merged integration PR: run the existing default-branch check unchanged to get evidence_sha on the default tip."
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:_default_branch_evidence() workflow_run branch (lines 437-468)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: When `workflow_id is not None`, _default_branch_evidence queries `repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/runs?branch={default_branch}&event=push&status=completed&per_page=1` and takes the head_sha of the latest COMPLETED push run with no comparison against the current default-branch tip, so a pending run at the latest tip is not represented. The weakness predates this PR and is inherited, but the PR extends it to a second code path (rated NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh | close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready, the state-write branch "if ! { jq ... "${STATE_FILE}" > "${STATE_FILE}.tmp" && mv "${STATE_FILE}.tmp" "${STATE_FILE}"; }; then"
  PROBLEM: When jq fails, a stale ${STATE_FILE}.tmp is left in the runner temp area. It is still reported as state_persist=failed, so behaviour is unaffected.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: add rm -f "${STATE_FILE}.tmp" before state_persist="failed" in that branch (1 line; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- NOTE: Dismissed these pass-1 items: (a) the merged-integration completed-run evidence, as behaviour the issue specifies; (b) empty ACTIVATION_VERIFY_ENABLED, which fails closed; (c) the smaller post_state_comment retry budget, as documented residual risk; (d) the test filename, as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED because ci.yml is outside the grant.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:_default_branch_evidence (lines 411-446) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The integration-branch logic in `verify_resolution` reuses `_default_branch_evidence`, which queries only completed default-branch runs and takes the first result.
  WHY: A newer pending run can let an older successful run that already contains the integration merge pass the compare, so the triage issue closes before the check is green on the current default branch tip.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15217-15219 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` has a fragile retry logic compared to `gh_retry` used elsewhere.
  WHY: It is retried only once. On permanent failure the `.tracking_auto_close` outcome is set but the state comment is not posted, so someone reopening the issue cannot know it was automatically closed.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "Add tests (see Tests). tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py: drive the function with a stub gh and fixture STATE_FILE, COMMENTS and labels."
  Expected change site: A new file `tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py`
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff and last-run diff contain `tests/orchestrate_tracking_auto_close_cases.py` instead of the requested `tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py`.

  Evidence of absence: The function takes the head_sha of the latest COMPLETED push run (`status=completed&per_page=1`) and never compares it with the current default-branch tip, so a pending run at the latest tip is not represented. The weakness is inherited from the pre-refactor path, but the PR extends it to a second code path.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:`verify_resolution`, lines 437-468 and 532-547 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The merged-integration-PR path gets default-branch evidence from the newest completed workflow run, not necessarily the current default-branch tip.
  WHY: The query filters to `status=completed` and takes the first result. If a newer default-branch run is pending, an older successful run containing the integration merge can pass the final compare and close the triage issue before the current default tip has a green check.
